plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Cisco switch. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, temperature, fan, power supply status, optical modules, and interface traffic, for Catalyst campus switches (enterprise PEN 9).
name: Switch

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports the CPU utilization of the Cisco device control plane (5-minute average, CISCO-PROCESS-MIB cpmCPUTotal5minRev). Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload, routing instability, or attack traffic, and may lead to slow management response or packet processing delays.

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: This metric reports the number of bytes currently in use for each Cisco memory pool (CISCO-MEMORY-POOL-MIB). It helps administrators understand the absolute memory consumption per pool (for example Processor or I/O pools) and identify which pool is under pressure.

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: This metric reports the number of free bytes available in each Cisco memory pool. Together with the used bytes it determines overall memory utilization; a persistently low free value indicates memory pressure on that pool.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: This metric reports overall memory utilization of the Cisco device, computed as used / (used + free) * 100 across all memory pools. High memory usage may indicate memory leaks, oversized routing/MAC/ARP tables, or insufficient capacity, and can cause instability or failed allocations.

metrics.name: device_temperature_celsius
metrics.description: This metric reports the temperature reading of each Cisco hardware sensor (CISCO-ENVMON-MIB), in degrees Celsius. Abnormally high temperatures may indicate fan failure, blocked airflow, or excessive ambient heat, and can trigger thermal protection or hardware damage if left unaddressed.

metrics.name: device_fan_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each Cisco cooling fan (CISCO-ENVMON-MIB ciscoEnvMonFanState). A non-normal state (warning, critical, shutdown, or notFunctioning) indicates a cooling fault that can quickly lead to overheating and should be investigated immediately.

metrics.name: device_psu_state
metrics.description: This metric reports the operational state of each Cisco power supply unit (CISCO-ENVMON-MIB ciscoEnvMonSupplyState). A non-normal state signals a power redundancy or hardware fault; on devices with redundant PSUs a single failure may not cause an outage but removes redundancy and must be remediated promptly.

metrics.name: device_optical_rx_power
metrics.query: (device_optical_value{instance_type='switch', sensor_type="14", descr=~"(?i).*(Rx Power|Receive Power).*", __$labels__} != -1000000000) * (10 ^ ((device_optical_scale{instance_type='switch', sensor_type="14", descr=~"(?i).*(Rx Power|Receive Power).*", __$labels__} - 9) * 3 - device_optical_precision{instance_type='switch', sensor_type="14", descr=~"(?i).*(Rx Power|Receive Power).*", __$labels__}))
metrics.description: Per-sensor SFP/optical receive power in dBm (CISCO-ENTITY-SENSOR-MIB entSensorValue, type dBm=14, descr matching Rx Power / Receive Power). Raw value is converted with entSensorScale and entSensorPrecision as value * 10^((scale-9)*3 - precision). The -1000000000 unread sentinel is dropped. A dropping RX level is an early sign of fiber attenuation, dirty optics, or a failing peer transmitter. IOS-XE/Catalyst path.

metrics.name: device_optical_tx_power
metrics.query: (device_optical_value{instance_type='switch', sensor_type="14", descr=~"(?i).*(Tx Power|Transmit Power).*", __$labels__} != -1000000000) * (10 ^ ((device_optical_scale{instance_type='switch', sensor_type="14", descr=~"(?i).*(Tx Power|Transmit Power).*", __$labels__} - 9) * 3 - device_optical_precision{instance_type='switch', sensor_type="14", descr=~"(?i).*(Tx Power|Transmit Power).*", __$labels__}))
metrics.description: Per-sensor SFP/optical transmit power in dBm (CISCO-ENTITY-SENSOR-MIB entSensorValue, type dBm=14, descr matching Tx Power / Transmit Power). Raw value is converted with entSensorScale and entSensorPrecision as value * 10^((scale-9)*3 - precision). The -1000000000 unread sentinel is dropped. An abnormally low TX level indicates a failing laser/optic rather than fiber attenuation alone. IOS-XE/Catalyst path.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifInOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable). The 64-bit counter avoids the rapid wrap of the 32-bit ifOutOctets on high-speed switch ports, keeping the rate accurate.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
